title: TikTok Pixel, Events API & Webhook Deduplication Architecture
overview: TikTok Events API provides a secure server-to-server connection enabling advertisers to share website and offline conversion events directly with TikTok for resilient measurement and optimization.
coreConcepts: Hybrid deployment: TikTok Pixel client-side tag + Server-Side Events API
Event deduplication key: matching event_id + event name between browser and server requests
Advanced Matching parameters (hashed email, phone, external ID) for higher attribution match rates
Real-time event verification inside TikTok Events Manager diagnostics dashboard
features: Batch event uploading with up to 50 events per HTTP payload
Standardized e-commerce events: ViewContent, ClickButton, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout, CompletePayment
Server-side test event mode via test_event_code parameter
bestPractices: Generate a unique event_id on the web application server and send it to both browser Pixel and Events API
SHA-256 hash email and phone numbers (normalized: lowercase, trim whitespace, E.164 phone format)
Always pass user context: ip, user_agent, and TikTok click identifier (ttclid) when available
Test server payload in sandbox mode using test_event_code before deploying to production
policies: TikTok User Privacy and Data Protection terms compliance
Prohibition against transmitting sensitive personal information (financial, medical, minors' data)
Explicit user consent compliance under regional regulations (GDPR/DMA/CCPA)
limitations: Events must be submitted within 7 days of occurrence (events older than 7 days are discarded)
API rate limit: 100 requests per second per advertiser account
Advanced Matching match rate typically lower than Meta due to smaller signed-in desktop web footprint
commonIssues: Events double-counted when event_id parameter is missing or mismatched
Low match quality when transmitting server events without user_agent or IP address
Invalid token error caused by expired TikTok developer application access token

troubleshootingGuide.resolution: Inspect browser Network tab and server outbound payload to confirm identical event_id strings

troubleshootingGuide.issue: Low match rate on TikTok Events API
troubleshootingGuide.resolution: Capture and pass the ttclid query parameter from landing page URLs into server-side conversion payloads
